title: Law to ban new smoking paraphernalia shops near schools
summary: This bill would prohibit retailers that sell smoking paraphernalia, such as water pipes, rolling papers and e-cigarette parts, from operating within 500 feet of any public or non-public school serving kindergarten through high school. The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, Department of Finance and Department of Consumer and Worker Protection would enforce the rule. It would take effect 60 days after becoming law.
